name: coding-rules-guard
description: FAST/FULL coding workflow with evidence-first validation and explicit cross-feature impact gates.

interface.shortDescription: FAST/FULL 分流，只加载当前阶段。
interface.longDescription: Coding Rules Guard uses a short FAST path for low-risk work, escalates to FULL for cross-layer or high-risk work, requires one smallest discriminating real check before a repair decision, and makes cross-feature impact assessment and honest disclosure mandatory. It prohibits deliberately wrong tests and redundant verification work, while keeping regression coverage for confirmed behavior.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose FAST or FULL and load only the current coding-rules phase. For each hypothesis, run one smallest discriminating real check first, then repair based on that result; assess callers, adjacent functions and public contracts before every write, and disclose known or unverified impacts honestly.
